pairs.subject: agent-cli-transport
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/session.rs:354 Dropping the session identifier upon hitting an account rate limit drops thread custody without a definitive verdict and re-dispatches subsequent prompts to a fresh CLI process without folding prior plan and turn context into the retry.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/health.rs:128 Probes CLI version and auth status without spending tokens via the child environment and distinguishes unavailable status from cached credentials.
crates/shadowrunr-engine/tests/fake_cli.rs:119 Asserts against the child-observed call log to verify that API keys and plugin directories were absent in the child.
crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/health.rs:19 Relies on a single constant version and help excerpts rather than a structured capability matrix tracking dates, methods, and feature requirements.
crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/fleet.rs:474 Implements explicit multi-tier descent across accounts, API, and alternative CLIs with recorded reasons and a scripted deterministic floor.
crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/claude_cli.rs:120 Engine runs headless batch/unattended streaming sessions with prompts set to none; no interactive attended human queue is routed.
crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/alt_cli.rs:105 Passes prompt via argv for agy instead of standard input stream to avoid Windows pipe blocking.
crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/claude_cli.rs:112 Passes requested allowed tools without a write-tool denylist layer that rejects write tools on read-only requests.
crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/claude_cli.rs:201 Strips API keys and parent session nesting variables at the single Command constructor door.
crates/shadowrunr-engine/src/session.rs:354 Unbinds session ID on account rate limits and retries the prompt on a new account without folding conversation history.

pairs.registryProposal: On Windows, CLI tools such as agy block on open stdin pipes unless pipe shutdown is handled specifically, prompting adapters to fall back to argument flags; the standard could document Windows pipe termination semantics for stdin prompt feeding.

declined.subject: agent-cli-transport
declined.reason: The daemon crate wires system components behind WebSocket/RPC endpoints and delegates all LLM execution to shadowrunr-engine without directly implementing the agent CLI transport adapter.
